findings.title: Claim form amount claimed does not match hospital and pharmacy bill total
findings.detail: The amount claimed on the claim form (33587.09) does not match the sum of the hospital bill total payable (33085.09) and the pharmacy bill (502.00), which totals 33587.09. Wait, 33085.09 + 502.00 = 33587.09. Let us check the hospital bill total again. Subtotal is 31509.61, tax is 1575.48, total payable is 33085.09. Plus pharmacy bill of 502.00 is 33587.09. Actually, let us check the hospital bill subtotal items: 8867.01 + 6919.90 + 2290.65 + 3538.59 + 2233.32 + 6610.14 + 600.00 + 450.00 = 31509.61. Subtotal + Tax (1575.48) = 33085.09. Claim form says Amount Claimed 33587.09. 33085.09 + 502.00 = 33587.09. The claim amount is correct. No error here.
